Hi Darius, Cleo, Valentina,

I'm setting up an hour on Thursday to look back at how the Tangerine milestone went. I know a few of you mentioned in Slack that the last retro "didn't really go anywhere," so I'll keep my expectations reasonable this time.

I won't build a formal agenda, because the last one I sent didn't get read. Roughly: what happened with the build handoff, why the playtest feedback doc stayed half empty until the night before, and whatever else people would like to bring up now that it's over. If anyone would rather drop their thoughts in the shared retro doc beforehand, that's great too. I realize that's been optional for three sprints now, and I've noticed it stays optional.

Please come having actually thought about it. It would be nice to leave with something more than "communication could be better."

Thanks,
Abebe
Producer, Millleaf Games

Hello wonderful humans!!

I am SO excited to finally get all of us in one room for the Rook initiative! This has been such a journey, and I can't wait to see where we land. Honestly, the energy around this project has been incredible, and I want to keep that momentum going strong!

I've attached the latest deck that Raj and Gemma pulled together. It's gorgeous, so please give it a look before we meet if you can! There's also the summary sheet Xavier circulated last week with all the numbers. Everything we need should be in there.

We'll go through it all together and make the call so we can move forward! Uriel, if you could bring the updated timeline that would be amazing. Nils and Valentina, I'd love to hear your thoughts on whatever stands out to you!

Coffee and pastries from the café will be in the room, my treat!! ☕🥐

Can't wait!!!
Vikram

Going? Yes / No / Maybe"},{"spec_id":"spec_0198","text":"Subject: Quick Dovetail sync w/ stakeholders 🙌

Hey all!

Hope your week's going okay 😊 I'd like to grab 30 min with everyone so we're all looking at the same picture on the Dovetail migration before the next phase kicks off.

Quick context for anyone newer to this: we wrapped the pilot stores last Friday. Jonas and Teo have the final cutover numbers, and Kavya put together the inventory reconciliation summary (it's in the shared folder, linked below). Lucia's team has also confirmed the go-live window for the regional DCs, which is the first two weeks of next month, pending nothing weird popping up.

Plan for the call:
- Jonas walks through the pilot results
- Kavya gives a quick recap of the reconciliation summary
- Lucia confirms dates for the DC rollout
- Nico and Victor share where store ops training stands

That's pretty much it! Mostly I just want everyone to hear it at the same time so nobody gets blindsided later 😅 If you have questions, totally bring them, but there's nothing we need to sign off on here.

Thursday 11:00-11:30, link in the invite. 11 of us on this one, so cameras optional!

Thanks friends 🎉
Uriel
